Social Security Office Hours in the Bronx

Knowing the Social Security office hours in the Bronx saves a wasted trip across the borough. The SSA's schedule has a few quirks — including Wednesday early closes and a long list of federal holiday closures — that catch many people out. This page explains the current hours for all five Bronx offices, the federal holidays when they close, and how to confirm hours before visiting.

The quick answer

All five Bronx SSA offices are generally open Monday through Friday during standard business hours, with Wednesdays often closing earlier (around noon) for staff casework time. All offices are closed on weekends and every federal holiday. Hours can change without notice, so confirm by calling 1-800-772-1213 before any visit.

The Wednesday early-close

Most SSA field offices nationwide — including all Bronx offices — close earlier on Wednesdays, typically around noon. This is to give staff time to process the casework backlog without the pressure of walk-in visits. A Wednesday afternoon visit will almost always find the office closed.

If you need afternoon service, plan for Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, or Friday. Mornings are universally busier than afternoons, so a Tuesday or Thursday afternoon generally has the shortest wait time.

Federal holidays when all Bronx offices are closed

  • New Year's Day (January 1).
  • Martin Luther King Jr. Day (third Monday in January).
  • Presidents Day (third Monday in February).
  • Memorial Day (last Monday in May).
  • Juneteenth National Independence Day (June 19).
  • Independence Day (July 4).
  • Labor Day (first Monday in September).
  • Columbus Day (second Monday in October).
  • Veterans Day (November 11).
  • Thanksgiving Day (fourth Thursday in November).
  • Christmas Day (December 25).

How to use the hours efficiently

Best practice: schedule an appointment in advance by calling 1-800-772-1213. With an appointment you will be seen close to your scheduled time even on busy days. Walk-ins are accepted but mean 1-2 hour waits at peak times.

For quick services (updating an address, requesting a benefit verification letter), check first whether the request can be completed online at ssa.gov — many of these no longer require an office visit at all, eliminating the hours question entirely.

Frequently asked questions

Are any Bronx SSA offices open on weekends?

No. All SSA field offices, including every Bronx location, are closed on Saturdays and Sundays. Use ssa.gov for any service available online.

What if I arrive close to closing time?

You may be turned away if there is not enough time to process your visit. Plan to arrive at least 30 minutes before closing — and earlier on Wednesdays when offices close around noon.

Can I call my Bronx office directly to confirm hours?

Direct local phone lines for field offices have been replaced by the national line at 1-800-772-1213. That number can confirm current hours for any specific Bronx office.

Are hours different around holidays?

Yes. Around major holidays, offices may have modified hours in addition to the holiday closure itself. Always confirm before visiting during holiday weeks.
